key_facts: DOD is soliciting proposals for AI-enabled call and message monitoring at the Military Correctional Complex at Fort Leavenworth, Kansas, due by Aug. 13.
The MCC holds more than 650 inmates and includes the U.S. Disciplinary Barracks, the DOD's only maximum-security facility.
The technology must be certified for Amazon Web Services' government cloud infrastructure and interface with the existing ViaPath Phone system.
Officials want semantic AI and agentic AI capable of detecting slang terms used to describe criminal activity or drug names.
The system should provide near-instant translation between Spanish and English and generate law enforcement assistance reports.
